title: Give credit while the details are still visible
description: Recognition becomes more useful when it names the work, preserves its context, and reaches the person who did it.

title: Be a good guest in another team
description: Entering an unfamiliar team calls for curiosity about local constraints before confidence about the solution.

title: Practice something that does not need to be published
description: Private practice gives a skill room to be awkward before it has to become a useful result.

title: The questions a useful tool still leaves to you
description: A tool can make an operation easier while leaving purpose, judgment, and responsibility unresolved.

title: Repair the misunderstanding before defending the sentence
description: When a conversation goes wrong, returning to the difference in meaning can be more useful than proving what was intended.

title: Hold the standard and explain the path to it
description: Careful work and respectful treatment belong in the same conversation about quality.

title: An introduction should make the next conversation easier
description: Connecting two people is more useful when the purpose, consent, and expectations are clear.

title: Stay with the unfamiliar word for a little longer
description: Technical language becomes useful when a definition connects to an example, a boundary, and a question you can answer.

title: Give the second version a different job
description: Revision is more useful when it tests the purpose of a piece of work instead of merely polishing its surface.

title: You can have a question without having a position
description: Some conversations become more useful when uncertainty is allowed to remain specific and unfinished.

title: Ask what makes the work urgent
description: A deadline becomes easier to handle when its consequence, source, and available choices are made explicit.

title: Share the question before it becomes a proposal
description: An unresolved question can invite useful collaboration when its context and boundaries are clear.

title: Ask why the ordinary work went well
description: A successful piece of work can reveal useful conditions that are easy to miss when attention goes only to failure.

title: Be reliable without becoming permanently available
description: Clear commitments and response expectations can make collaboration dependable without making every moment interruptible.

title: Choose the question before choosing the number
description: A measurement becomes useful when its denominator, purpose, and limits remain visible beside the result.

title: Carry the conditions with the good idea
description: A useful practice travels better when its original constraints remain attached to the recommendation.

title: Read outside your specialty without turning it into a project
description: Unfamiliar subjects can widen the questions you ask without needing an immediate professional application.

title: Make the decision without pretending the map is complete
description: Good judgment can name uncertainty, choose a proportionate action, and preserve a way to learn what happens next.

title: Describe the problem so someone else can help
description: A fair problem statement separates the observed difficulty from blame, preferred solutions, and assumptions about intent.

title: Let feedback arrive before deciding what it means
description: Receiving a comment, evaluating it, and choosing a response are different tasks that need not happen in the same instant.
